text:
sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's KV-cache OOM incident. Linking notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-oom. Summary: recurring fragmentation + slow GC under long-lived shards. I captured heap samples and a short timeline in the doc. Action items below, please ack and add ETA. :spiral_calendar:

kevin: Ack. I can take ownership of the profiling tasks and the evictions experiment.

raj: I'll own the GC tuning spike and jemalloc introspection. Will need a dev node for testing.

maya: Oncall follow-up: we saw two customer-facing errors during the spike window. I'll add rollback playbook steps to the runbook.

sophia: Action list (short):
- (A1) Collect continuous heap/alloc sampling for 48h on staging + a noisy dev region (owner: kevin, ETA: 48h)
- (A2) Run jemalloc fragmentation report and compare active vs resident patterns (owner: raj, ETA: 72h)
- (A3) Try 1-hour experiment: aggressive prefix eviction at 80% mem footprint (owner: kevin, ETA: 3 days)
- (A4) Add per-shard soft memory limit + OOM backoff that triggers a graceful drain (owner: raj, ETA: 1 week)
- (A5) Short-term mitigation: enforce node-level tenant caps and increase GC frequency for large-shard processes (owner: maya, ETA: today)
- (A6) Add recurring weekly check-in to ops backlog to watch long-tail regressions (owner: elle, ETA: next Monday)

kevin: For A1 — I'll run the pprof sampler on the staging shard group. Command I'm going to use:```
# sample every 10s for 6k samples
pprof -seconds 6000 http://staging-kv:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pb.gz
```
I'll also enable jemalloc stats export: set MALLOC_CONF="stats_print:true,lg_dirty_mult:4" for the experiment.

raj: For A2, steps:
- enable jemalloc epoch bumping and capture stats:```
curl -sS -XPOST http://localhost:6060/debug/jemalloc/epoch
cat /proc/self/status | grep VmRSS
```
- run fragmentation calc and export CSV to s3 (s3://redwood-debug/kv-frag/).
I'll push an infra branch that mounts /proc on the test container.

maya: For A5 temporary caps: I'll patch deploy pipeline to add env VAR: KV_SOFT_LIMIT_MB=45000 on the risky pool. Will also add alert rule: memory > 92% for 2min -> page oncall.

elle: A6 acknowledged. I'll schedule a 30m repeatable slot on the eng-runtime weekly board and add a small dashboard panel: per-shard fragmentation ratio over 7d.

kevin: Quick note on eviction experiment (A3): we need a safety rollback. Plan: canary 10% of shards -> observe 24h -> roll forward to 50% if errors < 0.1%. We'll tag canary with label: kv-evict-exp-2026-03.

sophia: Recurring pattern we observed: long-lived hot prefixes accumulate rarely-expired metadata and lead to resident set growth without corresponding active allocations, which jemalloc reports as background fragmentation. Proposed longer-term items (not blocking):
- (L1) Rework prefix compaction to trim tombstones periodically (owner: eng-ml? tentative)
- (L2) Explore compacting GC epoch across shards (owner: platform, exploratory)

raj: One extra ask — can we get a backtrace when OOM happens? The kernel logs truncated stack traces. Suggest adding a pre-oom diagnostic hook that writes /tmp/oom-dump-<ts>.tgz. Will prototype.

maya: added A5 patch to staging and rolled to canary pool (deploy-bot reported success). deploy-bot: "deploy succeeded: canary/kv-softcap-v1 -> 3 instances" :tada:

kevin: Started heap sampling job. Uploading initial sample to artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/kv/heap-samples/180150. Will post findings in ~24h.

elle: I've created dashboard panels and wired an alert: frag_ratio > 1.25 for 10m -> pager. Added to incidents channel.

sophia: We should also measure tail latency impact of eviction policy. Can someone add a perf job for 72h covering p95/p99? (kevin?)

kevin: Yep, adding another job. Command snippet:```
wrk -t12 -c200 -d30s http://staging-kv:8080/read?prefix=hot- > perf-hot-72h.log
```
I'll correlate perf with heap samples.

raj: ETA check: I can deliver jemalloc csvs and a frag report in 72h. Will need a short PR to read /proc stats.

maya: Oncall note: customer-facing errors were reduced after canary soft limits. We still saw two spikes during GC windows. I'm adding a follow-up to the customer incident thread.

sophia: Thanks team. Please update the postmortem doc with concrete links to artifacts and mark task done when complete. We'll reconvene in the weekly slot and decide whether to move A3 to prod. :eyes:

kevin: acked. Will update when we have 24h of samples.

raj: acked.

maya: acked.

elle: added calendar invite for the recurring check.

sophia: Closing the thread for now — ping if anything urgent.
